mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, it is 72 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and the moon is currently in its Third Quarter phase.
The Verona Senior Center is looking for pilots to help run their free tri-shaw bike program, while the Rec Department is currently accepting applications for various seasonal job opportunities.
There is plenty to do, starting with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market happening today, followed by Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In a recent report, an officer conducting a traffic stop on July 31 arrested a 27-year-old woman for an O W I after observing a flat tire and no activated taillights.
You can enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day at Culver's until they close at 10 PM tonight.
